Players Committee card image of [[Imperial Domination (V) (Virtual Set 1)]] (original printing), a retired Virtual Modern card (Virtual Set 1).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/imperialdomination.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). the file is still in the repository but no card uses it since 14 May 2020.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
